Joke Generator

45 clean, family-friendly jokes across animals, food, school, science, and general — filter by category and copy your favorites.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a joke category (or all).
  2. Press Tell Me Jokes.
  3. Click any joke to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many jokes are there?

45 original clean jokes, organized into animals, food, school, science, and general categories.

Are the jokes clean?

Yes — every joke is family-friendly and safe for kids, classrooms, and workplaces.

How do I copy a joke?

Click any joke or its Copy button to copy the setup and punchline together.
